summary: Bion Environmental Technologies filed an 8-K on July 14, 2026, disclosing a Settlement Agreement with Hamstra Builders Inc. to resolve mechanics liens and litigation over the Fair Oaks facility. Bion will issue a $1.77M convertible promissory note with 10% interest, maturity Dec 31, 2026, and a $653,915 cash payment due at a future financing. Holders of other convertible notes agreed to extend maturities to Dec 31, 2026 or Jan 31, 2027. This is a routine liability settlement involving convertible instruments, not a special situation. No M&A, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, restructuring, or liquidation.
